milestones.title: Phase 1 — MVP
milestones.description: Core library, views, search with language filter, activation on Windows/macOS/Linux, duplicates and problems. Gate: all non-functional targets met on the 10k reference library.

milestones.title: Phase 2 — v1.0 (internal)
milestones.description: Inspection depth, body text layouts, Compare, Quick Collection, smart collections, licensing, background agent, release engineering. Gate: daily-driver quality.

milestones.title: Phase 3 — v1.5 (internal)
milestones.description: Web export, specimens, online catalogs, visual similarity, Pairing Studio, local API endpoint, CLI, MCP server, shared libraries. Gate: developer and studio personas served.

milestones.title: Phase 4 — v2.0 (public release)
milestones.description: Plugin IPC, Adobe and Sketch plugins, missing-fonts watcher, find by image, Font Switch, native shell decision, public release. Gate: InDesign auto-activation works.

epics.title: Foundation and fm-api
epics.summary: The workspace, the CI matrix, the API contract and the reference library. Nothing in E2–E9 starts before E1.1–E1.3 are merged.

stories.title: Create the monorepo and workspace
criteria: Layout matches the Repository layout section of the breakdown (crates/, apps/desktop, plugins/, data/, fixtures/, scripts/, docs/)
`cargo build` and `pnpm install` succeed on a clean clone
`clippy -D warnings`, `rustfmt`, `cargo-deny`, ESLint and Prettier wired as `pnpm lint`
The five ADRs committed under docs/adr/ (Tauri, fontations, SQLite/FTS5, in-place library, open-core teams)

stories.title: CI matrix
criteria: GitHub Actions runs lint, `cargo nextest`, Vitest and a Tauri debug build on windows-latest, macos-latest and ubuntu-latest on every PR
A stale generated types.ts fails the build
cargo and pnpm caches are used; a warm run finishes in under 10 minutes per OS

stories.title: fm-api skeleton
criteria: fm-api defines the service traits (Library, Search, Preview, Activation, Organization, Export, Workflows) with request/response/error types
All types derive serde and specta; an ApiVersion constant and a typed Event enum exist
`pnpm gen:types` produces apps/desktop/src/api/types.ts
A MockApi implements every trait for frontend development

stories.title: Reference library
criteria: scripts/build-reference-library.sh downloads ~10,000 OFL/Apache/UFL fonts (Google Fonts repo plus Fontshare) into a local folder with a manifest of hashes
A 200-font subset is committed under fixtures/fonts/ including variable, color, TTC, WOFF2, a broken file and a Type 1 file
The script is idempotent and resumable

stories.title: Tauri app skeleton
criteria: apps/desktop opens a window on all three platforms with Vue 3, Pinia, Vue Router and the generated API client
One Tauri command (get_app_info) round-trips through fm-api
Dark/light theme follows the OS

stories.title: Logging, config and app paths
criteria: tracing with a rotating log file
Config lives in the platform app-data folder
fm-platform exposes paths for data, cache, logs and the library folder on each OS

stories.title: Error model and telemetry switch
criteria: One FmError type with user-facing message plus developer detail; errors cross the API as structured data
Telemetry and crash reporting exist as a config flag defaulting to off; nothing is sent when off

epics.title: Scanner and parser
epics.summary: Turns folders into faces. With E3 it is the MVP's critical path.

stories.title: Font file discovery
criteria: Given a source folder, lists every file with a font extension (ttf, otf, ttc, otc, woff, woff2, pfb, pfa, dfont) recursively
Skips hidden folders; follows symlinks once
Reports count and total size

stories.title: Parse with fontations
criteria: read-fonts yields all faces in a TTC; family/subfamily (name IDs 1/2); typographic family/subfamily (16/17); PostScript name; version; foundry; designer; copyright; license text and URL; OS/2 weight/width/fsType; post italic angle; fvar axes and named instances; GSUB/GPOS feature tags; cmap code points
A malformed file returns Health::Broken(reason) instead of panicking
A cargo-fuzz target runs 10 minutes clean

stories.title: Hashing and change detection
criteria: Each file gets a blake3 hash
A rescan skips files whose size and mtime are unchanged; a changed file is re-parsed
A removed file is marked gone, not deleted from the index

stories.title: Family grouping
criteria: Faces group by typographic family with fallback to family
Styles sort weight → width → slant; variable named instances appear as styles of their family
The 200-font fixture groups into the expected families (snapshot test)

stories.title: Watched folders
criteria: notify events (create, modify, remove, rename) update the index within 1 s
A debounce coalesces bursts
A periodic full rescan (configurable, default 1 h) catches missed events
A source can be paused and resumed

stories.title: Health checks
criteria: Broken/truncated files, missing cmap, zero glyphs and legacy formats (Type 1, dfont, bitmap) are flagged with a reason
WOFF/WOFF2 are parsed for preview and marked convertible

stories.title: Scan progress events
criteria: The API emits ScanStarted, ScanProgress {done, total}, ScanFinished {added, changed, removed, problems}
The UI stays responsive during a 10k scan

epics.title: Index and search
epics.summary: Turns faces into something searchable, including the language and character-set filter.

stories.title: SQLite schema and migrations
criteria: Tables as in the spec's data model; migrations run on startup
The index is rebuildable from sources through an API call
Corruption on open triggers a rebuild, not a crash

stories.title: Persist scan results
criteria: E2 output lands in font_file and face in one transaction per batch of 500
10,000 fonts persist in under 10 s on the reference machine

stories.title: FTS5 search
criteria: A query over family, style, PostScript name, foundry, designer and tags returns ranked, grouped-by-family results in under 50 ms on 10k fonts
Typo tolerance via trigram tokenizer
Style words narrow styles

stories.title: Filters
criteria: Filters for classification, weight range, width, slant, variable, color, format, feature tag, license type, source, health and activation state compose with AND and apply with search
Each filter shows its result count

stories.title: Classification heuristics
criteria: When the font gives no class (OS/2 panose/family class), heuristics on glyph outlines assign serif / sans / slab / mono / script / display with a confidence
The fixture's 200 fonts are ≥ 90% correctly classed against a hand-labeled list

stories.title: Character-set data
criteria: data/charsets/*.json defines required characters per language for Latin-script European languages, Cyrillic languages, Greek, Turkish, Vietnamese, Arabic, Hebrew, Thai, Devanagari and CJK basics
A schema and a validation test exist; contributions are a PR to a data file
Sources (Hyperglot, Google Fonts language data) are credited in data/charsets/README.md

stories.title: Coverage at scan time
criteria: Each face stores a compact bitset of its cmap
Per-language coverage is computed from E3.6 and stored
locl language systems are recorded from GSUB

stories.title: Supports filter (language and character set)
criteria: Filter by one or more languages (AND) or by pasted text
Results include "missing N" with the exact characters for near-misses within 5 characters
Filtering 10k fonts by language returns in under 50 ms
A locl badge shows for fonts with localized forms for the chosen language

epics.title: Preview rendering
epics.summary: Produces pixels: native webview rendering for the list, a core rasterizer for thumbnails and later the CLI and MCP.

stories.title: Webview font loading
criteria: A Tauri asset-protocol route serves a font file by face ID
The Vue list renders a preview row with @font-face pointing at it; variable fonts render with font-variation-settings
1,000 rows scrolled do not leak font faces (unused faces unloaded)

stories.title: Core rasterizer
criteria: fm-core renders a text string with a given face, size, color and axis values to a PNG via rustybuzz shaping and swash/cosmic-text rasterization
Output matches the OS rendering closely enough for thumbnails (visual comparison documented)
Reusable by grid thumbnails, the CLI and the MCP render_preview

stories.title: Preview cache
criteria: Rendered thumbnails are cached on disk keyed by face hash plus settings hash with an LRU cap (default 500 MB, configurable)
A cache hit returns in under 2 ms

stories.title: Preview controls
criteria: Sample text (custom, pangrams in 10 languages, lorem, alphabet, numerals, font name), size 8–300, line height, tracking, alignment, text/background colors and a light/dark preview surface apply to all rows live
Settings persist per view

stories.title: Dynamic previews
criteria: When the sample text contains characters a font lacks, the row falls back to text drawn from the font's own coverage (its script or its symbols)
A small "fallback" hint is shown

epics.title: UI shell
epics.summary: The window people use. Starts against MockApi so it runs in parallel with E2–E4.

stories.title: Three-column layout
criteria: Sidebar, font list and inspector with draggable dividers
The inspector collapses under 1,100 px and reopens with a shortcut; state restored on relaunch
Matches the spec's main-window drawing

stories.title: Virtualized font list
criteria: List view renders 10,000 families at 60 fps on the reference machine with row recycling
Expanding a family shows its styles inline
Keyboard navigation (arrows, Enter, Tab) and multi-select work

stories.title: Grid and waterfall views
criteria: Grid cards with thumbnails from E4.3
Waterfall shows the sample text at 6 sizes per family
Switching views keeps selection and scroll position by family

stories.title: Detail list view
criteria: Table mode with the spec's columns: activation dot, name, style count, weight line, weight range, format badge, version, manufacturer, location, license, date added, tags
Columns sortable, reorderable, hideable; configuration persisted
Preview strip above the table with its own size slider

stories.title: Search box and filter chips
criteria: / focuses search; results update within 50 ms of typing (debounced 80 ms)
Filter chips from E3.4 and E3.8 show under the list title with counts
A chip set can be saved as a smart collection (stub until E14)

stories.title: Inspector: Info tab
criteria: Shows every field from E2.2 for the selected face with copy-on-click for names and paths
Shows the activation button and the health badge

stories.title: Sidebar sources
criteria: Add, pause, resume and remove source folders through a native folder picker
Scan progress inline from E2.7
The System source is listed read-only

stories.title: Command palette and shortcuts
criteria: Ctrl/Cmd+K palette lists every action with fuzzy search
The spec's keyboard model is implemented
Every action is reachable without a mouse

stories.title: Settings window
criteria: Sections: Sources, Activation, Appearance (theme, density), Advanced (cache size, rescan interval, logs folder)
Changes apply immediately

stories.title: Accessibility baseline
criteria: Every interactive element has a label; focus rings visible
Screen reader announces family, style and activation state in the list
Contrast ≥ AA for chrome; reduce-motion honored

epics.title: Activation
epics.summary: The only MVP epic that touches the OS: spike first, then one implementation per platform with an integration test each.

stories.title: Activation spike (ADR)
criteria: A throwaway program on each OS registers a font from an arbitrary path for the session and for the user, and a second process can use it without restart
Findings recorded in an ADR, including Windows per-user registry behavior on Windows 10 and 11 and macOS scope semantics

stories.title: FontActivator trait
criteria: activate(faces, Mode) -> Result<Vec<Outcome>>, deactivate, list_active, conflicts(faces)
Errors are per-face, not all-or-nothing
A MockActivator exists for tests

stories.title: Windows implementation
criteria: Session: AddFontResourceExW plus WM_FONTCHANGE, removed on quit
Permanent: HKCU\…\Fonts entry pointing at the file in place, no admin prompt
Integration test launches a second process and finds the family via DirectWrite enumeration

stories.title: macOS implementation
criteria: CTFontManagerRegisterFontsForURL with session scope and user scope
Registration errors mapped to Outcome
Integration test enumerates via CoreText from a child process

stories.title: Linux implementation
criteria: Symlinks under ~/.local/share/fonts/font-manager/{session,permanent}/ plus fontconfig refresh
Session links removed on quit and on next start if left behind
Integration test uses fc-list

stories.title: Activation service
criteria: Activate/deactivate by face, family, collection or set through fm-api; state persisted
"Reactivate on launch" restores the last session's activations
The status bar count updates via events; 100 faces activate in under 500 ms

stories.title: Conflicts
criteria: Activating a face whose PostScript name matches a system or already-active font prompts keep / replace for session / cancel
A Conflicts view lists every clash and its winner
The app never deregisters fonts it did not register

stories.title: UI: activation controls
criteria: Activation dot on rows and cards; button in the inspector; A / Shift+A shortcuts
"Deactivate all" and "Deactivate everything not in the current set" in the palette
A toast with undo for bulk actions

epics.title: Organization
epics.summary: Collections, tags, favorites, ratings, sidecar metadata and project sets.

stories.title: Collections
criteria: Create, rename, nest, reorder and delete collections
Add faces or families by drag or palette; a face can be in many
Counts in the sidebar

stories.title: Tags, favorites, ratings
criteria: Free-form tags with autocomplete; favorite toggle; 1–5 stars
All filterable; the Info tab edits them

stories.title: Sidecar metadata
criteria: Collections, tags, ratings and notes for faces in a source are mirrored to <source>/.fontlibrary/<family-hash>.json
A change on disk (another machine via sync) merges on scan
Conflicts surface as a Problems entry; data is never silently lost

stories.title: Project sets
criteria: Named sets of faces; activate/deactivate a set in one action
Export/import as JSON referencing faces by hash with a report of unmatched entries

epics.title: Duplicates and problems
epics.summary: Find duplicates and broken files, resolve them safely with undo.

stories.title: Duplicate detection
criteria: Exact duplicates by hash and near-duplicates by PostScript name plus version at different paths are listed in groups
Each group shows the recommended keeper (newest version, then the one in the library folder), paths and sizes

stories.title: Problems view
criteria: One view lists duplicates, broken files, legacy formats, sidecar conflicts and activation conflicts with filters
Counts in the sidebar and status bar

stories.title: Resolve with undo
criteria: "Keep this one" moves the other copies to the OS trash (never permanent delete)
The action is undoable from a toast for 10 s and from the Problems history
A dry-run shows what will move

epics.title: Packaging, performance and the MVP gate
epics.summary: Runs alongside the other epics from sprint 2 so the numbers are watched while the code is written.

stories.title: Performance harness
criteria: scripts/bench.sh runs cold start, first scan of the reference library, incremental update, search latency, 100-face activation and idle memory on each platform and writes a JSON report
CI runs it nightly on main and posts a trend; a PR can request it via the `bench` label

stories.title: Performance budgets in CI
criteria: A PR that regresses any target in the spec's non-functional table by more than 10% fails the check and is flagged on the PR

stories.title: Dev builds
criteria: Unsigned installers from main: .msi/.exe, .dmg, AppImage
Artifacts attached to each nightly; version from the Cargo manifest plus the commit hash

stories.title: Crash safety
criteria: The fuzz corpus from E2.2 runs in CI weekly
Opening the fixture's broken fonts, a corrupted database and a missing source folder each produce a Problems entry, not a crash
A panic hook writes a crash log and restarts cleanly

stories.title: User docs, first pass
criteria: docs/ holds Getting started, Sources, Activation and Keyboard shortcuts pages generated into a static site
The in-app Help menu links to them

stories.title: Axes tab with sliders, numeric input and named instances

CSS value copy for axes and features

Drag-to-resize size and line height; pinch on trackpads
Per-block properties editor (size, line height, tracking, paragraph spacing, indent, columns, alignment)
Plain-text template files, duplicate, revert, version history
